nodes.title: Event log
nodes.summary: Replace the whole-file tree.json with an append-only .ambiflex/log.jsonl that Git merges without conflicts (merge=union); the tree is replayed from it; tree.json stays as a derived snapshot.
nodes.detail:
## Event log (Phase 2)

- `.ambiflex/log.jsonl`: one JSON line per change (`goal`, `upsert`, `merge`, `auto`), append-only, with the session id and a timestamp. `.ambiflex/.gitattributes` sets `merge=union` so two sessions' logs merge without conflicts.
- `replay(events)` rebuilds the tree in time order. When two sessions created the same id offline, the later one is renamed (`n7-b`) and that session's later references follow.
- `tree.json` stays as a derived snapshot (readable, synced to the mobile page). Cost is only in the snapshot.
- Migration: a session that finds a `tree.json` but no log converts it once (`eventsFromSnapshot`).

Judge: `claude plugin test` 25/25, migration script round trip `true`.
nodes.verification: claude plugin test: 25 pass (replay equals state, union of two divergent logs recovers both subtrees with renamed collisions, snapshot migration round-trips); real tree.json migrated to log.jsonl with an exact round trip

nodes.title: Calibrated estimates
nodes.summary: Three-point estimates (o/p/pess), critical path (done), arrival date in the header, calibration factor applied to new estimates (measured; the ×0.03 artefact from hand-set timestamps must be excluded).
nodes.detail:
## Calibrated estimates (Phase 3)

- Three-point estimates `1h/2h/4h` (optimistic / likely / pessimistic): expected value (o + 4p + pess) / 6, spread (pess − o) / 6. Single values still work.
- Calibration = median of actual / estimated over finished nodes, counting only real measurements: ≥ 2 min of work on an estimate ≥ 30 min, ratio within [0.05, 20]. The ×0.03 artefact from hand-set timestamps is now excluded.
- Expected end: the calibrated critical path turned into a calendar date (8h days, Monday to Friday; around the clock in auto mode), with ± from the three-point spread. Shown in the panel, in `tree_get` and when auto mode starts.
- The method tells Claude to multiply new estimates by the reported calibration factor.

Judge: `claude plugin test` 28/28.
nodes.verification: claude plugin test: 28 pass (PERT value and spread of "1h/2h/4h", calibration rejects hand-set timestamps and keeps a 3h-on-2h measurement at ×1.5, arrival skips nights and weekends unless continuous)

nodes.title: Nodes ↔ branches ↔ PR
nodes.summary: One track = one branch or worktree; a node shows its commits and PR; "Validate" on a node with a PR proposes the merge (never merges alone).
nodes.detail:
## Nodes ↔ branches ↔ PR (Phase 4)

- An agent spawned with `#<id>` gets that node its own branch `ambiflex/<id>-<slug>` in a worktree under `.ambiflex/worktrees/<id>` (git-ignored); the agent is told to work and commit there, never on the main checkout.
- The panel shows, per node with a branch, its commits beyond `main` and its PR when `gh` can report one; the Git tab refreshes them after every git command.
- "Validate" on a node with a branch asks Claude to propose the merge of that branch (or its PR) and never to merge without explicit confirmation.

Judge: `claude plugin test` 29/29 and a real-repo run of the worktree commands.
nodes.verification: claude plugin test: 29 pass (an agent spawned for #n1 gets `git worktree add .ambiflex/worktrees/n1 -b ambiflex/n1-perf-track`, its prompt names the worktree, the node records the branch and the panel shows it); the same git commands verified on a real temporary repository (worktree, commit, `git log main..branch` lists it)

nodes.title: Adoption strategy
nodes.summary: Umbrella for n10-n15: settled when its children are. The plugin now treats goal nodes as umbrellas (their children are workable while they stay open) and works the plan in the order it was written.

nodes.title: Proof before promo
nodes.summary: No launch without a real measured demo: a project run with 3 tracks in parallel, estimated vs actual time, a 60-second video. Needs calibrated estimates (n5) first.

nodes.title: Contenu > plugin
nodes.summary: Ce que font les gens remarqués : ils publient leurs apprentissages, pas leur outil. Une série d'articles « ce que j'ai appris en pilotant des agents » avec données.

nodes.title: Distribution
nodes.summary: Méthodes du lancement produit : répertoire officiel, awesome-lists, Show HN, réponse directe au tutoriel de Felix, communauté Claude Code.

nodes.title: Boucle de rétention
nodes.summary: Le buzz ne fait pas l'usage : l'historique et la calibration des estimations (phase 2-3) rendent le plugin plus utile à chaque projet. C'est ce qui retient.

nodes.title: Mesurer l'adoption
nodes.summary: Juge externe : étoiles, installs du marketplace, issues ouvertes par d'autres, PR externes. Objectif à 90 j : 500 étoiles, 10 contributeurs.

nodes.title: Lancement
nodes.summary: Jour J : vidéo + article + dépôt public + post qui répond à Felix. Tout prêt avant, publié le même matin.
